name: spielebox
description: Search the WIENXTRA-Spielebox board game library in Vienna, check availability, and send reservation requests.
long_description: Unofficial access to the online catalog of the WIENXTRA-Spielebox (opac.wienxtra.at), Austria's largest board game library: search ~9000 games with filters for players, age and play time, see the availability of each copy, collect games on a reservation list and send it as a reservation request. Reservation requests are binding; you confirm each one yourself, in a form or on a page in your browser. Your contact details are only used to prefill that confirmation.
